messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "given in divided doses"
set: ["given in divided doses", "dose is given in 3 divided doses", "taken in divided doses", "2000 mg/day in divided doses", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses", "10 mg orally per day in divided doses", "150 mg orally per day in divided doses", "450 mg/day in up to 4 divided doses", "5 to 60 mg per day in divided doses", "this is eight 50 mg tablets in divided doses", "given in vein", "given in muscle", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses for narcolepsy", "daily dose divided into three equal doses", "10 to 15 mg/kg/day given in 3 divided doses for patients 3 to 11 years of age", "given as two divided doses up to the same maximum 37.5 mg daily limit"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "dose is given in 3 divided doses",
    "taken in divided doses",
    "2000 mg/day in divided doses",
    "5 mg orally per day in divided doses",
    "10 mg orally per day in divided doses",
    "150 mg orally per day in divided doses",
    "450 mg/day in up to 4 divided doses",
    "5 to 60 mg per day in divided doses",
    "this is eight 50 mg tablets in divided doses",
    "daily dose divided into three equal doses",
    "10 to 15 mg/kg/day given in 3 divided doses for patients 3 to 11 years of age",
    "given as two divided doses up to the same maximum 37.5 mg daily limit"
  ],
  "alias": "given in divided doses"
}
